iopair.name: C-C839A-PSQL-08-ST02-DT05-DF05-CF18-01-GOOD-01
iopair.description: initalize a database Read an integer from the input. If integer >= 4096, do nothing.Else malloc a buffer of 4096 bytes. Memset the buffer to 'a'. Memset bytes of buffer from input_integer to 4095 to 'b'. Print the buffer. This all works correctly if the input_integer is 0 or greater. If input_integer is negative, we will try to memset a random place in memory. If the input_integer is sufficiently large, this is unaddressable, and we get a segfault.
